title: Desk Guidance: Service Recovery for Parking Tenants who also Rent a Self-Storage Unit
content:
**Applies to:** billing-error correction credits on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement where the tenant also rents storage under a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

**Rule.** The service-recovery amount — the service-recovery share multiplied by the rent it is measured on — is multiplied by 2 for a tenant who also holds an active storage unit rental moved into at least 24 months before the handling date, and by 1.5 for a tenant whose active storage unit rental was moved into more recently than that. The multiplication is made before the amount is compared with the service-recovery ceiling. A tenant with no active storage unit rental receives no adjustment under this rule.

**Records read.** The tenant's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records: whether a rental stands active, and its move-in date. Months are whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date, counted to the same day of the later month.

| Input (storage unit records) | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Active unit rental, moved in 24 or more months ago | Long-standing storage tenant | Service-recovery amount multiplied by 2 |
| Active unit rental, moved in fewer than 24 months ago | Newer storage tenant | Service-recovery amount multiplied by 1.5 |
| No active unit rental (none held, or only ended ones) | Not a storage tenant for this rule | No adjustment |

Hypothetical illustration: a share-of-rent amount of $4.40 for a tenant whose active storage unit rental was moved in 30 months ago becomes $8.80 before it meets the ceiling; at 10 months it becomes $6.60. At exactly 24 months the multiplier is 2.
